description: A later live-session result proves that planned validation has begun and that the access setup is complete; the parent, siblings, and root resume must move while the broader outcomes stay open or planned.

seed_operations.title: Run the booking pilot with the first partner site

seed_operations.title: Get the partner account onto the staging site
seed_operations.summary: The partner needs a working account and access before any live session can happen.

seed_operations.title: Validate the staging environment under real use
seed_operations.summary: Saves, reconnects, and concurrent bookings need a real session on staging rather than local checks.

seed_operations.title: Run live sessions with the partner
seed_operations.summary: The live sessions test whether the booking flow is understandable and where it breaks for real staff.
seed_operations.resume: Run the full booking flow with the partner and note confusion, slow steps, and failures before expanding scope.

seed_operations.title: Prepare the public release
seed_operations.summary: After the pilot findings and staging risks are addressed, prepare the listing, metadata, and rollout plan.
seed_operations.resume: Begin only after the live-session findings and staging risks are addressed.
